key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of solar-cell measurements require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers directly from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures across 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Evaluate structured SQL access using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature, compared with 1.6–6.5% zero-shot accuracy.
watch_item: Structured access still leaves nearly half of questions incorrect, and implementation depends on extracting and maintaining trustworthy device tables.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
